Three.js 0.180.0, vendored from the official npm package `three@0.180.0`.
Package SHA-1: b930cabfb524f6d36bf63e874b4d866888b50487.

`three.module.js` is the upstream `build/three.module.min.js`; its local dependency is the unmodified `three.core.min.js`. Only RoundedBoxGeometry, FontLoader, RoomEnvironment and the Optimer regular font are included from examples. See LICENSE and fonts/LICENSE.

No runtime CDN or package installation is required.
